title: Memos Requesting The Arrest Of Yu Hsi-Chiu

page_data.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O.BOX 280. SHANGHAI.
11th November, 1931.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have
received the following telegram from His Majesty's
Consul-General at Canton:

"The Canton Government requests that
the Shanghai Commissioner of Police be
asked to arrest Yu Hsi-chiu ( 余 錫 九 )
whose family resides at No.21 Tienshou li
on Ko ming lu, Shanghai, on a charge of
absconding with public funds. I have
pointed out that the request should be
addressed to the Senior Consul, but in
order to save time, I was pressed to send
you this telegram."

If I receive any further information from
Canton on this subject, I will communicate it
to you.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Captain R.M.J.Martin,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Consul-General.
page_data.zh:
英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱280号，上海。
1931年11月11日。

先生：

谨此奉告，本人已收到英王陛下驻广州总领事发来的下列电报：

“广州政府请求请上海警务处处长逮捕余锡九（Yu Hsi-chiu），其家属居住于上海克明路天寿里21号，罪名为携公款潜逃。本人已指出该请求应致函资深领事，但为节省时间，对方敦促本人向您发送此电报。”

如本人就此事从广州收到任何进一步信息，将随即转达阁下。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

R.M.J.马丁上尉，
警务处处长，
上海工部局。

总领事。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2881
Date 11/11/31

November 11, 1.

URGENT

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your telegram
dated November 9 which reached us yesterday afternoon
requesting the arrest of one Yu Shih Kiu (俞錫九)
and to inform you that the telegram was immediately passed
to the Chief of the Public Safety Bureau of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai as the address mentioned
is not within the jurisdiction of this department.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Sgd:- (R. C. AIERS.)

Deputy Commissioner (Crime).

Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Canton.

Sent out.
11/11/31. W.P.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2881
日期 1931年11月11日

11月11日。

急件

先生：

兹确认收到阁下11月9日发出、于昨日下午抵达本处的电报，要求逮捕俞錫九（Yu Shih Kiu）一名，并告知阁下，鉴于所提及地址不在本部门管辖范围内，该电报已立即转呈大上海市公安局局长。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
签署：（R. C. AIERS.）

副警务处长（刑事）。

广州公安局局长。

发出。
1931年11月11日。W.P.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2881
Date 11. 11. 31.

Translation: of Telegram
Recd 10/11/31.

Captain Martin,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

I have to inform you that one Yu Sih Kiu
(俞錫九) absconded with a sum of money and is
now hiding at No.21 Ti Shou Li (天壽里), Cumming
O.O.L. 11. Road (克明路), Shanghai, and shall be glad if
Chapei dist. you will promptly detail officers to investigate
and effect arrest after which to await extradition
by this department.

Kindly send me a reply by cable.

(Chopped) Shiang Han Bing (香翰屏)
Chief of the Public Safety Bureau,
Canton.
The 9th inst.

C.F.
Cable received 5.25 pm 10th
Passed to Public Safety Bureau
as it is O.O.L. Letter will
be drafted explaining

Ruth
11/11    10/11    D.C. (CRIME)
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2881
日期 1931年11月11日。

电报译文
收讫日期 1931年11月10日。

马丁上尉，
警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

谨此奉告，俞錫九（Yu Sih Kiu）携款潜逃，现藏匿于上海克明路（Cumming Road）天寿里（Ti Shou Li）21号，如闸北分区能迅速派遣警员进行调查并实施逮捕，随后等待本部门办理引渡事宜，本人将不胜感激。

恳请复电。

（盖章）香翰屏（Shiang Han Bing）
广州公安局局长。
本月9日。

C.F.
电报于10日下午5时25分收到
因属越权管辖（O.O.L.），已转交公安局
将起草信函予以说明

Ruth
11月11日    11月10日    副警务处长（刑事）
